headline: Amazon and Meta Talk Ending the Muse Shopping Block

bullets.t: Amazon and Meta talk letting the Muse AI agent shop on Amazon again.
All YouTube creators can now set custom Shorts thumbnails.
Cloudflare's free 'Search for Agents' lets AI agents search your site.
OpenAI says GPT-6 designed proteins that bound targets in lab tests.
Anthropic study: about 1 in 5 company AI rollouts delivered no value.
EA adds an AI-recreated John Motson voice to FC, with family consent.
UAE Cabinet approves AI assistant strategy. Mira rolls out from March 2027.
Huang apologises to Nvidia staff and admits a code-of-conduct breach.
California's attorney general opposes Character.AI selling user chat data.
Radar: the Motson AI commentary update lands Thursday.

radar.t: Watch for: EA's AI John Motson commentary update going live in EA Sports FC
Watch for: whether Amazon lets Meta's Muse agent back in before Black Friday
Watch for: court fight over Character.AI selling user chat data
